capability_investigated:
generate(features, prompts, **kwargs) and how WhisperProcessor builds
input_features — specifically whether the prompts list and a list-input to
the processor support batching multiple 30s windows in one decode call.
what_i_learned:
The stub decodes only one 30s window, so all audio past 30s is deleted on
multi-minute 0715 calls. The backend's generate already accepts a list of
prompts (one per batched feature row), and processor(list_of_arrays) returns
batched input_features — so consecutive 30s windows can be decoded as one
batch without leaving the frozen surface.
hypothesis:
Split audio into consecutive 30s windows, batch them through a single
generate call with one prompt per window, and join the decoded texts. This
recovers the deleted tail and should raise length_ratio.p05 and sharply
lower corpus_cer from the deletion-dominated baseline.
